name: hero-research
description: HERD: Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation for Continual Learning research implementation

scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm eval:test && pnpm opd:test && pnpm opd:validate && pnpm analysis:test
scripts.analysis:test: uv run --project packages/evaluator/python --with matplotlib --with numpy --with pytest pytest experiments/code/tests && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests
scripts.dataset:build: pnpm dataset:select && uv run --frozen --project packages/baselines/base python scripts/build-trace-plus-17.py
scripts.model:setup: uv run --project packages/hero-drift-constrained-opd/python --python 3.12 python -m hero_qwen.model_registry --root experiments/checkpoints/qwen3.5-4b download-base
scripts.model:status: uv run --project packages/hero-drift-constrained-opd/python --python 3.12 python -m hero_qwen.model_registry --root experiments/checkpoints/qwen3.5-4b show
scripts.site:check: pnpm --filter @hero/official-website lint && pnpm --filter @hero/official-website test && pnpm --filter @hero/official-website build
